sloka: शाद्वलेषु यद् आसिष्ये वन अन्ते वन गोरचा ।कुथा आस्तरण तल्पेषु किम् स्यात् सुखतरम् ततः ॥२-३०-१४॥
transliteration: śādvaleṣu yad āsiṣye vana ante vana goracā ।kuthā āstaraṇa talpeṣu kim syāt sukhataram tataḥ ॥2-30-14॥

translations.english: O rover of the forest I will feel happier when I sleep on the meadows (of tender green grass) on the outskirts of the forest than when I sleep on the couch spread with carpets.
